_meta.purpose: Seed list of Arabic book/novel Telegram channels for the book-bot fallback userbot.
notes: All entries are public channels (joinable without admin approval).
Tier 1 = large general libraries (50k+ subs), Tier 2 = 10-50k specialized, Tier 3 = smaller niche.
Priority: Tier 1 first (broadest coverage), Tier 2 to fill gaps, Tier 3 for adversarial books.
Userbot must throttle joins: 1 channel / 60-90s to avoid TG flood-wait.
After initial join run, an auto-discovery cron expands the list weekly.

tier_3_to_discover._strategy: Auto-join via contacts.search with these Arabic keywords after manual tier_1/2 setup is verified.
tier_3_to_discover.estimated_coverage: After auto-discovery + rate-limited joining over 2-3 weeks, expect ~150-250 channels in total.

channels_to_avoid._reasoning: Patterns that produce low-quality results or risk for the userbot.
patterns: Channels with last-post-date > 6 months ago (dead channels)
Channels that post only audiobook MP3s (we want PDFs)
Channels that re-upload everything from one specific website (duplication)
Channels with < 1000 subs unless verified as high-quality niche
Channels labelled 'private group' (cannot be joined publicly)
